auditor_jane: Hi team — SOC2 auditor here. We need chain-of-custody + playback evidence for the incident on 2026-02-11 around 03:12 UTC. Specifically: full audit log export (request traces), KMS/HSM key usage for keystore operations, S3 export manifest with checksum, sampling methodology for logs included, and explicit repro steps used to recreate the API 503s and the associated billing spike. Please include exact S3 prefixes, export filenames, and any redaction notes.

maria_security: Thanks, Jane. Can you confirm the exact time window you want and any request IDs you already have? I'll coordinate the export and provenance artifacts. @support-bot will create a ticket to attach to this thread.

support-bot: Ticket RED-3247 created and attached to thread. Owner: devops_john. ETA requested.

auditor_jane: Window: 2026-02-11 03:00:00 to 2026-02-11 04:30:00 UTC. Primary endpoint: POST /v1/generate (prod). Example request IDs: r-9a3b7f2c and r-91f2c4b8 — we saw traces for those in our partial logs. Need playback for at least those two and a sampling of surrounding 5 minutes.

maria_security: Got it. We'll produce: 1) full request-trace export for the window, 2) KMS audit records (key usage logs, HSM callouts) for the same window, 3) S3 manifest + sha256 of exported bundle, 4) a short doc describing how we sampled traces and any redaction applied. devops_john — can you run the export and post the S3 prefix + manifest hash here?

devops_john: Starting export now. Commands I'm running (internal-only):
```bash
# trigger audit export job
./infra/playbooks/run_audit_export.sh --start 2026-02-11T03:00:00Z --end 2026-02-11T04:30:00Z --output s3://redwood-audit-exports/2026-02-11/RED-3247/

# copy keystore-audit bundle to staging bucket (server-side encryption: aws:kms)
aws s3 cp /tmp/keystore-audit-20260211.tar.gz s3://redwood-audit-exports/2026-02-11/RED-3247/keystore-audit.tar.gz 
```
I'll post the manifest once the job completes. Note: export includes request-level traces, span IDs, and the keystore access log entries we capture from the HSM provider.

sre_lee: For reproducibility of the 503/latency spike, here's the lightweight repro we use in-house: send a controlled burst to /v1/generate with a consistent prompt size to force long context and KV pressure. Example (replace TOKEN):
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
    -H "X-Request-ID: repro-$i" 
    -H "X-Trace-Id: repro-trace-$i" 
    -d '{"model":"gpt-large", "prompt":"A very long prompt... (repeat 4k tokens)", "max_tokens":512}' &
done; wait
```
When you run this, capture the server response headers (X-Request-ID, x-server-latency-ms, x-model-variant). Also grab /metrics and the trace spans (we've got a one-click span dump on the console). This reproducer was used during the incident analysis.

auditor_jane: Thanks. For chain-of-custody we need: who initiated the export (user + principal), provenance logs showing the export job run, the exact S3 object keys, a sha256 over the exported bundle, and where the manifest is stored (internal GCS/S3 + access time). Also: any HSM audit logs that show key authorization events (signing/unwrapping) for the keystore operations in that window.

maria_security: Understood. Quick clarifications: 1) is the auditor ok with the export being redacted for PII (email, user text)? 2) any preference for full raw traces vs redacted partials? We typically provide redacted copies for external auditors but can also run a controlled non-redacted export under an NDA.

auditor_jane: We can accept redacted copies if the redaction procedure is documented and reproducible. For verification, we need the manifest sha256 to confirm integrity and the redaction script + list of fields removed. If there's an NDA path for raw traces, please notify.

devops_john: Export finished. Posting manifest and S3 prefix: s3://redwood-audit-exports/2026-02-11/RED-3247/
Manifest: manifest-20260211-RED-3247.json
Manifest SHA256: 4f9a2d3b7c1e2a9b5d6f3e8a9c2b1f0d7e5c4a3b9d8e7f6c5b4a3d2c1f0e9a8
Objects in prefix (sample):
- request-traces-20260211-03_00-04_30.ndjson.gz
- keystore-audit-20260211.tar.gz
- export-manifest.json
I uploaded the manifest with server-side KMS encryption and logged the upload event in cloud-audit.

maria_security: Adding provenance notes: export initiated by principal "svc_audit_runner@redwood" (IAM role: audit-exporter-prod) at 2026-02-12T09:12:02Z (job schedule rerun due to throttling retry). Upload completed 2026-02-12T09:47:11Z. Manifest and metadata stored at s3://redwood-audit-exports/2026-02-11/RED-3247/export-manifest.json. The upload event has a cloud-audit entry id: ca-8f7e6d5c.

kate_compliance: Retention notes: request-trace logs are retained 365 days by default (prod audit policy). Keystore operation logs (KMS/HSM) are retained 7 years per our enterprise retention schedule for cryptographic custody records. For SOC 2 evidence, we keep the manifest, checksum, and export provenance for the above windows. Redaction policy: we redact direct user identifiers and full prompt text by default; we keep hashes for correlation. doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/compliance/retention (internal link).

auditor_jane: Can you confirm whether HSM provider logs include callouts (IP, principal, operation type) and whether they are part of the keystore-audit tarball or only in provider console? We need the preserved HSM audit events for the timeframe.

devops_john: The keystore-audit.tar.gz includes HSM callouts that we receive via the provider's streaming audit connector (we persist a copy). It contains entries like:
```text
2026-02-11T03:12:45Z | key-id=keystore-main | op=UNWRAP_KEY | principal=svc-mgmt | src_ip=10.23.45.67 | correlation=r-9a3b7f2c
```
We redacted internal IPs to the RFC1918 format in the bundle but preserved the src ASN and provider-side IDs.

auditor_jane: Good. Two last asks: 1) please provide the redaction script or command used, and 2) estimated timeline for handing over the export + proof-of-integrity to the auditor workspace (or upload link).

maria_security: Redaction script: we use a scrubber that runs over ndjson and replaces email-like patterns, credit-card regexes, and long prompt fields. Example (internal):
```bash
jq -c 'del(.user.email) | .prompt = (.prompt | sub(".{200}"; "<REDACTED_PROMPT>"))' < request-traces.ndjson > request-traces.redacted.ndjson
```
I'll attach the full scrubber logic in the compliance package. ETA for upload to auditor workspace: 36 hours (we need to complete review, additional sampling, and legal sign-off).

auditor_jane: 36 hours is fine. Please also include a short reproducibility checklist we can run — we may run the repro in our test tenancy and compare hashes.

sre_lee: Repro checklist (short):
- Use the repro script above with 200 concurrent requests using the same prompt length.
- Capture first-party headers: X-Request-ID, X-Trace-Id, x-server-latency-ms.
- Pull traces for the X-Trace-Id values from the console within 5 minutes.
- Verify that keystore ops correlate to request traces via correlation IDs.
We'll include a small shell script in the package that automates these steps and produces a local manifest of captured IDs for comparison.

maria_security: Upload ETA confirmed: 36 hours. I'll post the auditor workspace link in this thread when ready and include export-manifest.json, scrubber script, keystore-audit tarball, and a short sampling methodology doc.

auditor_jane: Thanks everyone — that's exactly what we need. I'll review the package when available and follow up if we need a non-redacted export under NDA. :thumbsup:

kate_compliance: Acknowledged. I'll monitor and escalate if legal is needed for NDA.

devops_john: Closing loop — uploaded to s3 and kicked off cross-account transfer to the auditor workspace. Will post link once transfer completes.

maria_security: Link posted: https://audit-workspace.internal.redwood/RED-3247/2026-02-11-export (access limited to auditor_jane + kate_compliance).

auditor_jane: Received link, starting intake. Will confirm checksum match with manifest. Thanks all.
